title: Implement per-group pinning policy engine
description:
Implement PolicyEngine that evaluates whether a given article CID should be pinned, based on rules from config: pin_all_groups: bool, pin_groups: [list], max_age_days: u32, max_size_bytes: u64. Implement should_pin(article: &ArticleMetadata) -> bool. Artifact: transit/src/retention/policy.rs.

Acceptance:
- pin_all_groups=true pins everything regardless of other rules
- pin_groups=[list] pins only articles in those groups
- max_age_days excludes articles older than threshold
- Rules are AND'd: an article must satisfy all applicable rules to be pinned
- Unit tests for each rule and combination
